description: The `tracon` global tool. It applies pending migrations as a separate deployment step (`migrate`, `migrate status`), reports read-only whether this build can still read the stored state before an upgrade (`state-check`), reads the health endpoint through Tracon.Client (`health`), runs an eval suite as a CI quality gate (`eval`), and writes the gate skill a coding agent loads before it touches a Tracon surface (`agent-skill`).
